title: Scholarship and Playlist
premise: Sebastian Okafor, a scholarship student at Ashford Academy, has spent four years keeping her head down and counting days to graduation — until her best friend Priya vanishes overnight, leaving behind a set of keys to the school's locked records annex. Following the trail, Sebastian uncovers that Priya was investigating how the academy quietly expels scholarship students to protect its donor families' legacies, and that Sebastian herself is on next term's list. Torn between loyalty to the friend who kept this from her and the truth that could destroy her own future, Sebastian must expose the scheme before the final lacrosse game of the season, where the headmaster plans to announce his 'renewed commitment to merit.' She tells the truth at midfield, costing her the friendship she fought for but winning it back in a harder form — honest, rebuilt, and hers.
about_author: Dominic Blackwood is a former boarding school teacher who spent six years watching brilliant kids learn which silences were expected of them. He writes young adult fiction about institutions, friendships under pressure, and the cost of belonging.

chapters.title: Ninety-Three Days
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Opening on a routine spring morning, Sebastian counts down to graduation while navigating the social gulf between scholarship kids and legacies, anchored by her friendship with Priya Raman. The chapter establishes her survival strategy: stay invisible, stay grateful, stay quiet. Emotional beat: restless anticipation shadowed by a loneliness she won't name.

chapters.title: The Empty Bed
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Priya misses morning classes, then doesn't answer texts; by evening her bed is stripped and her dorm key returned, with no withdrawal paperwork filed. In the hallway trash, Sebastian finds a lanyard with unfamiliar keys and a torn note reading 'if I'm wrong about this, laugh at me later.' Emotional beat: dread crystallizing into fear.

chapters.title: Keys
chapters.summary: Alternating POV begins — short interstitial chapters from Priya's journal entries dated before her disappearance. Sebastian tries the keys against campus doors until one opens the records annex, a basement archive no student is meant to enter. Inside she finds folders labeled with scholarship students' names, including her own. Emotional beat: betrayal's first sting — Priya went looking without her.

chapters.title: The Merit List
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. The folder reveals a pattern: each year, two or three scholarship students are pushed out mid-year over manufactured 'conduct concerns,' always replaced by full-pay legacies. Sebastian's name appears on a draft list for next fall. Headmaster Voss catches her leaving the annex and offers a warm, chilling warning. Emotional beat: terror wearing the mask of courtesy.

chapters.title: What Priya Knew
chapters.summary: Priya's journal POV. Flashback chapters reveal Priya discovered the scheme after her older brother was expelled under identical circumstances years earlier, and that she deliberately hid it from Sebastian to keep her safe. The journals end abruptly three days before the disappearance. Emotional beat: grief reframing anger — Priya's silence was protection, not exclusion.

chapters.title: Loyalty Has a Price Tag
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Sebastian confides in Marcus Cole, legacy teammate and her quiet crush, who urges her to stay silent until graduation — one scandal could void every scholarship in her cohort. Her lacrosse coach, an ally, hints the administration is watching her. Emotional beat: love against duty, as staying loyal to Priya means risking everyone like her.

chapters.title: The Game Before the Last Game
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. At the semifinal, Sebastian spots Voss meeting privately with the board chair, and realizes the 'merit announcement' planned for the championship game will formalize the purge. That night someone ransacks her room searching for the keys — which she'd hidden inside her stick bag. Emotional beat: paranoia tightening; there is no neutral ground left.

chapters.title: Where Is Priya
chapters.summary: Dual POV converging. Sebastian traces Priya's last journal clue to a bus station locker containing evidence files and a phone that finally pings — Priya fled town after being threatened, too scared to come back. Sebastian calls her; the conversation is raw, both apologizing for different silences. Priya gives her the missing piece: Voss's signature on forged conduct reports. Emotional beat: reconciliation through shared purpose.

chapters.title: Midfield
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Championship day. With the board assembled in the stands, Sebastian must choose between the safe speech she rehearsed and the truth. At halftime, microphone in hand, she reads the forged reports aloud, names Priya, and holds up the merit list as the crowd goes silent. Voss moves to cut the sound; students begin recording. Emotional beat: climax — courage as a public, irreversible act.

chapters.title: Encore
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV, weeks later. An independent investigation suspends Voss; scholarships are protected, though the victory feels smaller and messier than she imagined. Priya returns to finish the semester, and their friendship restarts honestly — no more secrets, no more protecting each other from the truth. The final scene: graduation countdown replaced by a shared playlist, track one already playing. Emotional beat: resolution — belonging earned, not granted.
